name: HubSpot Support Ticket Topic Cluster Categorizer (dhRobin Systems)

parameters.content:
## n8n-hubspot-support-ticket-topic-cluster-categorizer
**dhRobin Systems** · Open HubSpot tickets → redacted text → LLM categorization (category, theme cluster, sentiment, priority) → cluster merge + protected diff → HubSpot batch update + product-feedback digest.

**Safe by default.** With no environment variables set:
- `SANDBOX_MODE=true`: synthetic tickets and categorizer. **Zero external calls.**
- `DRY_RUN=true`: updates are computed, nothing is written.
- `SYNC_TO_HUBSPOT=false`: CRM writes need an explicit opt-in.

Personal data is redacted **before** the LLM. Unchanged tickets (content hash) and human-locked tickets are never re-sent.

### Pinned synthetic payloads
Pinned: schedule, webhook, ticket pipelines, ticket search, ticket batch read, LLM (1 response = 1 chunk of 8 tickets), HubSpot batch update.

Pins apply to **manual executions only**; production runs ignore them. Unpin a node before a manual live test of that integration.

nodes.name: Categorization Schedule
nodes.notes: Hourly at :41. Catches anything the webhook missed.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Ticket Webhook
nodes.notes: Subscribe to ticket.creation and ticket.propertyChange (subject, content). Responds 200 immediately.

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Typed, non-secret configuration under config.*; webhook request fields pass through.

nodes.name: Resolve Trigger & Verify Webhook
nodes.notes: scan vs. webhook mode, v3 signature, loop guard, de-duplication.

nodes.name: Mock Ticket Retrieval
nodes.notes: Twelve fictitious tickets, one per path.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Get Ticket Pipelines
nodes.notes: Open/closed stage metadata for both modes. Scope: tickets.

nodes.name: No Webhook Tickets: End
nodes.notes: See counters on Resolve Trigger & Verify Webhook.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: $('Config & Safety Gate').first().json.config.ticketProperties, inputs: $('Resolve Trigger & Verify Webhook').first().json.ticketIds.map(id => ({ id })) }) }}

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Read Tickets
nodes.notes: Webhook mode: reads the changed tickets (≤ 100).

nodes.name: Build Ticket Search Request
nodes.notes: Open AND (uncategorized OR new OR older taxonomy).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Search Tickets
nodes.notes: Scan mode: stops paging once MAX_TICKETS_PER_RUN is covered.

nodes.name: Select & Redact Tickets
nodes.notes: Eligibility, content hash skip, PII redaction, LLM chunking.

nodes.name: Nothing to Categorize: End
nodes.notes: See stats on Select & Redact Tickets.

nodes.name: LLM: Categorize Ticket Batch
nodes.notes: One request per chunk of BATCH_SIZE tickets, RATE_LIMIT_DELAY_MS apart. OpenAI-compatible, strict JSON schema.

nodes.name: Attach LLM Responses
nodes.notes: Index pairing with a hard count guard.

nodes.name: Normalize, Cluster & Diff Evaluator
nodes.notes: Schema validation, cluster merge, protected diff, product-feedback digest.

parameters.jsCode:
// Emit one item per HubSpot batch update (≤ 100 tickets each).
return $('Compose Update Batches & Run Stats').first().json.updateBatches.map((inputs, batchIndex) => ({ json: { batchIndex, inputs } }));

nodes.name: Log Run Stats
nodes.notes: Final summary and product-feedback digest on every path.
